title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Exodus 10: the locusts, the three days of darkness and Pharaoh's final warning to Moses.

questions.text: To whom did Yahweh want Moses to tell the signs he had done in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said Moses should tell in the hearing of his son and his son's son what things he had done to Egypt.

answers.text: His son and his son's son

questions.text: Who did Moses say would go to hold a feast to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Moses said, "We will go with our young and with our old... with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds."

answers.text: Only the men who were able to work
Only the elders and the priests
Young and old, with flocks and herds
Only Moses, Aaron and the elders

questions.text: Whom did Pharaoh allow to go after Moses' answer about who would go?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh said, "Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve Yahweh," and they were driven out from his presence.

questions.text: What did Yahweh use to bring the locusts?
questions.explanation: Yahweh brought an east wind on the land all day and all night, and in the morning the east wind brought the locusts.

questions.text: What was left after the locusts had eaten?
questions.explanation: The locusts ate every herb and all the fruit the hail had left; nothing green remained in all the land of Egypt.

answers.text: Only the wheat and the spelt
Only what was in Goshen's fields

questions.explanation: Yahweh sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts and drove them into the Red Sea.

questions.text: How long did the thick darkness last over Egypt?
questions.explanation: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.

questions.text: What did the children of Israel have during the darkness?
questions.explanation: Nobody rose from his place for three days, but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

questions.text: What did Pharaoh want to stay behind when he let the people go to serve Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh said, "Go, serve Yahweh. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind."

questions.text: What did Pharaoh warn Moses at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh said, "Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!"

answers.text: That he would die on the day he saw Pharaoh's face again
That the Israelites would work twice as hard
That the plagues would be blamed on him
That he must leave Egypt by morning
